description: This source file contains functions for plotting behavioral observation data, including bar plots of behavior durations and counts, as well as Gantt chart style event plots. It interacts with a database to retrieve event information and creates visualizations using matplotlib, tailored for behavioral research analysis within the BORIS software framework.

methods.name: default_value(ethogram, behavior, parameter)
methods.description: Returns default value for behavior parameters, particularly for duration in point events, depending on event type.

methods.name: dict init_behav_modif( ethogram: dict, selected_subjects: list, distinct_behav_modif, include_modifiers, parameters, )
methods.description: Initializes a dictionary of behaviors and modifiers for selected subjects based on the provided ethogram, behavior modifications, and parameters.

methods.name: dict init_behav(ethogram: dict, selected_subjects: list, distinct_behaviors, parameters)
methods.description: Initializes a dictionary of behaviors for selected subjects based on the provided ethogram, behaviors, and parameters.

methods.name: dict create_behaviors_bar_plot( pj: dict, selected_observations: list, param: dict, plot_directory: str, output_format: str, plot_colors: list = cfg.BEHAVIORS_PLOT_COLORS, )
methods.description: Creates bar plots for behavior durations and occurrence counts across subjects, based on aggregated event data from the database; supports saving figures to specified directory.

methods.name: create_events_plot( self, selected_observations, parameters, plot_colors=cfg.BEHAVIORS_PLOT_COLORS, plot_directory="", file_format="png", )
methods.description: Generates a Gantt-style timeline plot of behavior events for selected observations and subjects, with configuration options for time intervals and inclusion of modifiers.
